create.title: Typed Vaaler-height variation and dyadic-transfer obstruction
create.statement_tex: For fixed X and dyadic label j, H_j=floor(D_j X^(-1/4)) is external to the Mellin contour variables and has zero mu,nu,alpha,beta velocity, so it creates no alpha Cauchy-Green floor delta. For a_H(h)=1_(1<=h<=H) Phi(h/(H+1)), the adjacent difference a_(H+1)-a_H is positive, includes the full new endpoint h=H+1, has exact l1 mass 1/2, and has 1/h-weighted mass asymptotic to 1/(H+1); more generally its fixed power-weighted norms have the sharp Vaaler endpoint orders. The new endpoint is O(H^(-2)), while old frequencies carry the remaining mass. Exact dyadic scaling gives H_(j+1)=floor(H_j/2), and ||a_K-a_H||_1=|K-H|/2, so an actual dyadic height change has H-sized unweighted and order-one 1/h-weighted coefficient capacity. The complete physical/Mellin difference additionally changes D_j, profile, support, star, scale powers, radial factors and normalization. Therefore the unit-height lemma is not an alpha seam estimate or an actual dyadic-block estimate.
create.next_action: Construct the complete coupled adjacent-dyadic-scale difference on a common positive-line alpha antecedent and prove a signed scale-partial-sum theorem or capacity no-go.

update.statement_tex: The connector-completed alpha-bounded zeta-high trace remains the signed projected cosine-comb/GAR-return operator. The Vaaler floor H_j is not a moving alpha-contour seam: it has zero contour velocity. Although a formal unit-height coefficient change has exact l1 mass 1/2 and 1/h-weighted size asymptotic to 1/H, actual dyadic scaling sends H_j to floor(H_j/2), giving H-sized unweighted coefficient variation, while D_j, the denominator profile, support, equality star, Mellin powers, radial factors, and normalization change simultaneously. The next lawful local object is therefore the complete coupled adjacent-dyadic-scale difference on one common positive-line alpha antecedent. Prove a signed partial-sum estimate for that full family, then the outside-height Cauchy limit and global arithmetic sum. Coefficient-only height differencing and floor seam incidence are rejected routes.
update.next_action: Write the exact coupled difference between adjacent physical dyadic scales on a common positive-line alpha antecedent, including both height families, profiles, supports, stars, scale powers, radial terms and normalization, and prove a signed partial-sum bound or sharp no-go.

reject.reason: For fixed X and block j, H_j contains no contour variable and all alpha/beta contour velocities vanish. The multiplier (H_j+1)^v is entire in v and does not create a floor delta.
An actual adjacent dyadic scale has H_(j+1)=floor(H_j/2), not H_j plus or minus one; its coefficient-only l1 variation is comparable to H_j, and all profile and scale factors also change.
The new endpoint is O(H^(-2)), but old frequencies retune coherently and give exact total adjacent l1 mass 1/2.

no_change.reason: The full alpha transition remains open.
Round 52 proves coefficient algebra and a type correction only.
No uniform full M1 estimate is proved.
No new Gauss-circle exponent is claimed.

round_assessment.reason: Round 52 proves an exact sharp Vaaler variation theorem, corrects a type error in the alpha program, and identifies the complete coupled dyadic-scale family as the next lawful object. It does not estimate that family or improve the global exponent.
